labelChirho: be righteous, be in the right
descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to be righteous, be just, be in the right — the basic stative meaning across all persons, numbers, and genders.
Piel sense: to justify or declare righteous in an intensive-declarative mode, often reflexive or applied to another party.
Hifil causative sense: to declare righteous, justify, acquit, or vindicate someone — the standard forensic/legal declaration.
Hifil factitive sense: to turn or lead others to righteousness, making them righteous (Daniel 12:3).
Hitpael reflexive sense: to justify or clear oneself, to seek self-vindication.
Nifal passive sense: to be vindicated, be restored to right standing or proper order.
